dct_description_sm: At head of title (in manuscript): No. 9.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Civil War salted paper maps. Drainage and Union fortifications are in blue, and Confederate positions are in red. The map includes roads, railroads, towns, street pattern of Chattanooga, houses, names of a few residents, vegetation, and relief by contour lines. Relief shown by contours. At head of title (in manuscript): No. 9. Date from Stephenson's Civil War maps, 1989. Library of Congress.
